Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance window & contingency ledger — proposal to protect close date

Hi Susan / procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per our conversation, we captured the two items that are currently the highest risk to the 2027-05-03 target close date:

1) Procurement signature lag (legal review + PO issuance) — estimated 7–10 business days.
2) Integration readiness for the data retention controls on your side (S3 bucket lifecycle + KMS policy) — small config changes but depends on infra team bandwidth.

Attached is a compact proposal: a phased acceptance window that lets StellarCorp begin sandbox validation and limited production calls while procurement and infra finish their work, plus a one-sheet contingency ledger that outlines credits, fallback routing to a compatible model variant, and a short SLA carve-out for the first 30 days.

Asks:
- Can procurement confirm an expected PO issuance date by EOD Mon 4/5?
- Is there a liaison from your infra team we can loop in for the KMS item (I suggested Tim Lee but please correct me if wrong).

If procurement needs more time, we propose a single rebaseline option (Option B below) that staggers the final acceptance into two discrete gates to avoid an all-or-nothing delivery. I laid both options out in the attached MAP_v4_staggered.pdf.

Note: this is a proposal to protect the overall business outcome (go-live for features A/B) — we want to avoid last-minute scope drops that erode the value you'll get.

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi Susan / procurement team,

Appreciate the quick updates and Tim's bandwidth. To be explicit about outcomes and avoid ambiguity during the legal review, Redwood can offer Option A (original single-gate close on 2027-05-03) or Option B (staggered acceptance):

Option A — Single acceptance gate (target 2027-05-03)
- Full production switch after PO and final KMS confirmation.
- No financial carve-outs; standard usage billing applies.

Option B — Staggered acceptance (recommended if PO slips)
- Gate 1: Sandbox-to-limited-production on 2027-05-03 for up to 30 concurrent calls; Redwood provides limited validation credits covering the first 7 days of limited production (documented in Contingency_Risk_Ledger.xlsx).
- Gate 2: Full production acceptance after PO issuance and formal sign-off (target 2027-05-17).
- If PO exceeds 4/20, an automatic rollback and a negotiated credit schedule is triggered per the ledger.

Ask: Confirm by EOD 4/6 which option you prefer. If you choose Option B, we will:
- Publish a short MAP amendment (attached) and update the HubSpot deal stage to "Acceptance: phased".
- Schedule a 30-min technical sync (Action: Diego + Tim + Stellar infra lead).

Connor/Marissa — please add the MAP amendment to the HubSpot file and prepare a DocuSign envelope once Stellar confirms.

Regards,

Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Please proceed with the MAP amendment and the DocuSign envelope. We appreciate the validation credits for the initial 7 days.
